description: Days, months and business days between dates, add or subtract durations, ISO week numbers and day of year, and DST-aware elapsed time between local times. Operations: "diff" — Difference between two dates in years/months/days, total days, weeks and business days.; "add" — Add or subtract a duration ("1y 2m", "-90d", "P2W") or a number of business days.; "info" — Weekday, day of year, ISO week, quarter and leap year for a date (plus Unix time of local midnight).; "elapsed" — Exact elapsed time between two local date-times, following DST in each time zone.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: diff: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). add: The date (YYYY-MM-DD). info: The date (YYYY-MM-DD). elapsed: Start as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM".

operation.description: diff — Difference between two dates in years/months/days, total days, weeks and business days. add — Add or subtract a duration ("1y 2m", "-90d", "P2W") or a number of business days. info — Weekday, day of year, ISO week, quarter and leap year for a date (plus Unix time of local midnight). elapsed — Exact elapsed time between two local date-times, following DST in each time zone.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

businessDays.description: Business days to add (negative to subtract), up to 1,000. Used by: add.

end.description: diff: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). elapsed: End as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM". Used by: diff, elapsed. Required by: diff, elapsed.

endTimeZone.description: IANA zone of the end (default: same). Used by: elapsed.

holidays.description: diff: Comma-separated YYYY-MM-DD dates excluded from business days. add: Comma-separated holidays for businessDays. Used by: diff, add.

timeZone.description: info: IANA zone for the midnight timestamp. elapsed: IANA zone of the start. Used by: info, elapsed.

name: date-calc
title: Date Calculator
